verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a broad GraphQL API (transcripts, uploadAudio, analytics, audit events, active_meetings, super-admin overrides) plus an official MCP server exposing additional actions like share/move meeting and soundbite creation, showing real effort toward API/UI parity. However, there's no evidence that key UI-only features (AskFred conversational assistant, live multi-language switching, admin rules engine/automation workflows, private storage configuration) are fully exposed via API — AskFred and admin automation are described only as product features, not API endpoints. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP equivalents for AskFred, live transcription settings, multi-language mode toggling, and admin rules engine automation, plus any explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity.
